sql: select count(distinct support_tickets.id) as value from accounts left join support_tickets on support_tickets.account_id = accounts.id where accounts.tenant_id in ('acme') limit 100
select count(distinct support_tickets.id) as value from accounts left join support_tickets on support_tickets.account_id = accounts.id where accounts.tenant_id = $1 limit 100

select sum(invoices.gross_amount_cents) as value, accounts.region as region from accounts left join subscriptions on subscriptions.account_id = accounts.id left join invoices on invoices.subscription_id = subscriptions.id where accounts.tenant_id in ('acme') group by accounts.region limit 100
